meta.title: Nourish
meta.description: Skills that feed a family. Learner and parents decide together.

footer.disclaimer: Prototype for Smart India Hackathon 2026 — not an official government portal.

common.emptyBody: Start with one trade or one worry. We will not fill the gap with a guess.
common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again. Your saved plan stays on this device.
common.offline: You are offline. Saved plans and cached trade cards can still open.

home.title: Skills that feed a family.
home.lede: The parent often decides. Counsel the learner and the parent in one room, in their language, with local pay and placement figures they can open.
home.trust1: Every figure shows its source, period, and group size
home.trust2: A counsellor takes over when the guide should stop
home.trust3: Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, and English — by voice or by tap
home.noVerifiedYet: No verified earnings figure for this preview yet. Explore trades to see tiered data.
home.ladderChip: {trade} · NSQF level {level} — check the ladder before you pay fees
home.kicker: Family decision support for vocational education
home.problem: Enrolment stalls when a household is unsure about pay, job security, or social standing. This room answers that household, then shows scheme staff where the same worry still blocks a district.
home.o1b: Parent and learner speak in the same room. A six-digit code joins the other phone when work keeps a parent away.
home.o2b: Placement and monthly earnings come from the dataset for that trade and place. The guide cannot type a salary.
home.o3b: How this certificate maps to a job, the next NSQF step, and a later diploma — in words a family can repeat at home.
home.o4t: A person, when the guide should stop
home.o4b: Call, WhatsApp, or a counsellor who joins with the worries and the figures already written down.
home.o5t: A map of where families still hesitate
home.o5b: Scheme staff see the district, the worry — pay, status, a daughter’s travel, or a degree — and whether the figure shifted the parent’s stance.
home.askTitle: Start from the sentence a parent actually says
home.askHint: Tap one. The room opens ready to answer that sentence first.

evidence.outOfTen: out of 10 placed in the cohort window

start.title: Who is here?
start.lede: Name who will speak. A parent’s worry is answered before a course list.
start.learnerHint: The learner speaks. A parent can join later with the six-digit code.
start.parentHint: The parent speaks first. The learner can answer in the same room.
start.togetherHint: Both are here. Switch who is talking before each message.
start.assistedHint: For an ITI help desk or CSC. Big type. The screen clears after five quiet minutes unless you save.

room.title: Family Room
room.placeholder: Say the worry in your own words
room.empty: Tell Disha what is on your mind. A parent’s worry is welcome first.
room.boardRule: Pay and placement come only from the dataset. If a figure is missing, Disha says so and offers a counsellor.
room.noWorry: No worry logged yet. Tap a question below, in the parent’s words.
room.whoSpeaks: Who is sending the next message?
room.shareCode: Read this code to the person on the other phone. They open Family Room and type it.
room.evidenceIn: A source card is in this conversation.
room.joinHint: Enter the six-digit code. Messages refresh every few seconds.

explore.title: Explore trades
explore.lede: Open a trade for the local pay range, how many were placed, the next step on the ladder, and who this trade is a poor fit for.

plan.title: My Plan
plan.empty: Shortlist a trade to build a plan you can print or send.

talk.title: Talk to a human
talk.body: A counsellor can join this room. Helplines stay on this page if you need them now.

help.title: Help
help.voice: Tap the mic, speak, and read the caption. If the mic is missing, type, or open this page in Chrome.
